purpose: Hand-maintained catalog definitions for markers that production data_center_provider_coverage governs as live but that no source pack or formula specification adds to marker-registry.json. scripts/build-derived-governance.js appends a definition only while the committed database-governed status snapshot/overlay marks the id live or partial, so a definition never promotes a marker on its own.
source: Supabase project uvkvaxljhhngydvlrzom: data_center_provider_coverage (scopes, provider notes) and derived_formula_registry (formula, explanation), read-only audit 2026-09-29.
alias_note: Alias ids are live provider ids for the same field as an existing catalog marker (the Data Workbench column set uses several of them). They are recorded as marker_aliases in the registry instead of being listed twice in the catalog.

markers.label: Address city (locality)
markers.description: Familiar address locality from the NJ Office of GIS statewide geocoder. It can differ from the parcel's official municipality.

markers.label: Dwelling units
markers.description: Number of dwelling units on the MOD-IV parcel record.

markers.label: Property use code
markers.description: Property use description on the MOD-IV parcel record.

markers.label: Property ZIP code
markers.description: Five-digit ZIP code of the property location on the parcel record.

markers.label: Chapter 123 screen
markers.description: Chapter 123 screening result with plausible-sale checks. A screening position only, not appeal eligibility or legal advice.

markers.label: Assessment-to-sale ratio (Chapter 123)
markers.description: Assessment divided by the recorded sale price after the sale plausibility screen.

markers.label: Chapter 123 common level ratio
markers.description: Published common level ratio for the property's taxing district.

markers.label: Chapter 123 upper limit
markers.description: Upper limit of the Chapter 123 common level range for the property's taxing district.

markers.label: % above Chapter 123 upper limit
markers.description: How far the assessment sits above the Chapter 123 upper limit, in percent.

markers.label: Chapter 123 supported assessment
markers.description: Screening-supported assessment when the current assessment is above the Chapter 123 upper limit.

markers.label: Estimated assessment reduction
markers.description: Estimated screening reduction to the Chapter 123 supported assessment. Not an appeal outcome guarantee.

markers.label: Estimated annual tax difference
markers.description: Estimated annual tax difference implied by the Chapter 123 screening reduction.

markers.label: Score history: observations
markers.description: Number of trusted Watchdog Score observations supporting the longitudinal metrics. At least two are required.

markers.label: Score history: span in days
markers.description: Calendar days between the earliest and latest trusted Watchdog Score observations.

markers.label: Watchdog Score change
markers.description: Latest minus earliest trusted Watchdog Score in the observation window. Requires at least two observations.

markers.label: Watchdog Score 30-day trend
markers.description: Observed Watchdog Score change normalized to 30 days. Not a forecast.

markers.label: Watchdog Score volatility
markers.description: Population standard deviation of the Watchdog Score across trusted observations, in score points.

markers.label: Tax pressure change
markers.description: Latest minus earliest trusted tax-pressure score in the observation window.

markers.label: Tax pressure 30-day trend
markers.description: Observed tax-pressure change normalized to 30 days. Not a tax forecast.

markers.label: Tax pressure volatility
markers.description: Population standard deviation of the tax-pressure score across trusted observations.

markers.label: Revaluation risk change
markers.description: Latest minus earliest trusted revaluation-risk score in the observation window.

markers.label: Uniformity score change
markers.description: Latest minus earliest trusted assessment-uniformity score in the observation window.

markers.label: Appeal readiness
markers.description: Homeowner appeal-readiness context: 50% governed appeal evidence strength and 50% evidence-chain completeness. Both inputs are required. Not a prediction of success or legal advice.

markers.label: Tax appeal evidence strength
markers.description: Canonical alias of the governed Appeal Evidence Strength model. Not legal advice or a prediction of appeal success.

markers.label: Comparable evidence quality
markers.description: 70% governed comparable-evidence reliability and 30% appraisal public-record completeness. Both inputs are required.

markers.label: Title evidence completeness
markers.description: Completeness of the defined municipal-search, recording-reference and parcel-identity public evidence. Not a title opinion or lien clearance.

markers.label: Closing clearance confidence
markers.description: Public-record closing triage confidence from title evidence completeness, inverse closing exception priority and parcel identity confidence. Does not certify clear title.

markers.label: Site approval complexity
markers.description: Public-record screening of overlapping review contexts: regulatory density, environmental encumbrance and title/public-land constraints. Not a buildability or permitting determination.

markers.label: Open permit gap present
markers.description: 0 when the DCA permit provider reports no permit-issued/certificate gap; 100 when one or more gaps are present.

markers.label: Latest permit record age
markers.description: Calendar years since the latest DCA permit record. Not the age of a physical condition or proof that work remains open.

markers.label: Permit record age attention
markers.description: Latest permit-record age scaled to 0-100 over ten years; context for an existing permit or certificate gap.

markers.label: Exit liquidity score
markers.description: Investor screening score from inverse marketability drag, property story confidence, inverse carry-cost volatility and inverse asset constraints. All four inputs are required. Not a sale-timing or price forecast.

markers.label: Portfolio data confidence
markers.description: Evidence-coverage score from property story confidence, physical-risk source coverage and municipal source coverage. Measures evidence, not investment quality.

markers.label: Municipal fiscal beta
markers.description: Screening score for property-tax sensitivity to local levy and ratable-base imbalance and reset pressure. Not a statistical beta or tax forecast.

markers.label: Fiscal intervention priority
markers.description: The strongest of four governed municipal pressure screens: tax-base absorption, exemption pressure, tax-rate pressure and revaluation risk. Not a fiscal distress determination.

markers.label: Revenue base resilience
markers.description: Municipal screening score from ratable growth quality, collection resilience and inverse exemption pressure. Not a revenue forecast or credit rating.

markers.label: Service cost vs. ratable growth gap
markers.description: Levy growth minus ratable-base growth from the governed DCA budget model. Positive values mean levy growth is outpacing organic ratable growth.

markers.label: Five-year tax-rate history completeness
markers.description: Share of the official 2021-2025 municipal general tax-rate fields that are present. Evidence depth only.

markers.label: Redevelopment incentive exposure
markers.description: Municipal context from governed PILOT value share and abated tax-base share. Does not infer eligibility or agreement terms.
